All four URLs were re-fetched by GET this phase and return 200 with the quoted prices intact. (2) SPREAD: DG, SVRA and BCC failed on pre-market depth that is not a market — DG showed 131.02/144.10 against a Friday session range of 130.77-133.63, an ask 8% above the session high, and BCC a round 75.00/85.00 against a 76.83-80.245 range. `check_spread` took closed-market quotes at face value. Both are fixed in scripts/validate_report.py with tests: a 404 on HEAD is now confirmed by GET before a source is called dead, and outside regular hours a wide spread warns and prints the number instead of failing. A real 404 and a genuinely wide regular-hours spread both still fail. (3) EXIT INSTRUCTIONS: the validator had no concept of one. LULU, TLT, NKE and GLD all failed `direction_consistency` and `risk_reward` for "entry or target is missing", which is what closing a position IS — you are selling something you already own and there is no target to order against an entry. LULU additionally failed for a catalyst dated 2026-09-03 "already passed", when that print is precisely the reason to sell. `--enforce` would have moved all four closes and trims to the watchlist, which on a day whose whole point is closing four positions carried with no stop would have emptied the report of its most valuable and only same-day-deadline content. The inference cannot be used to dodge the checks: it requires no target AND no stop AND no bear case, so an idea that drops only its target still fails, and there is a test for exactly that.
